summary: Priyansh and Kaushal have outlined a strategic overhaul of the Sigma Pro pricing architecture to better reflect its market value. The plan transitions the service to a sophisticated three-tiered model and introduces a 15% price increase. To maintain growth, they focused on optimizing the free trial experience, implementing a grandfathering clause to protect the loyalty of existing members, and offering annual discounts to strengthen upfront cash flow. This logical restructuring is designed to provide a clear pathway toward reaching an annual revenue milestone of $2.3 million by Q2 2025.
